title: Handoff verify input
description: Input contract for kaizen-handoff verify — points the verifier at a handoff YAML file. Optional `repo_root` lets the caller pin git operations to a specific working tree (defaults to cwd).

file.description: Absolute or relative path to the handoff YAML to verify.

repo_root.description: Git working tree root for the verification checks. Defaults to the current working directory.
